correctness.rationale: Complementary p-values give tan(pi(1/2-(1-U)))=-tan(pi(1/2-U)) exactly. Hence T=sum_j(w_{j,+}-w_{j,-}) C_j with independent standard Cauchy C_j; its characteristic function is exp(-|t| sum_j |w_{j,+}-w_{j,-}|). The scale A and degenerate case, weighted cancellation identity, exact upper tail, strict monotonicity for alpha<1/2, iff A=1 standard calibration and alpha-to-zero attenuation all follow. Independent rational weights (3/10,1/10),(3/20,1/20),(2/5,0) gave A=7/10 by both definitions, and several numeric Cauchy-tail checks passed. This proves finite m and normalized nonnegative deterministic weights.
residual_risks: Assumes exact complementarity and independent latent blocks; no extrapolation to approximate Gaussian anticorrelation.
